name: Nemean Roar
body:
You unleash a primal roar to scatter the cowering mice before you.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, bellowing voice racial trait, Dazzling Display OR wild empathy class feature.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you may make a single Intimidate check against all enemies within 30 feet.

Roll once and compare the result against the DC of each creature. If an affected creature is already shaken, it instead becomes frightened for the duration you would have caused it to be shaken.

Normal: Using Intimidate to demoralize an enemy can’t raise their fear level above shaken.
